name: AirQualityAdvisory
description: An air-quality advisory carrying two independent time axes as flattened period-boundary pairs. phenomenonTimeStart and phenomenonTimeEnd bound the one-hour averaging window over which the mean PM2.5 concentration was computed — this is the period of the world the result is about. effectiveTimeStart and effectiveTimeEnd bound the period during which the advisory is in force — this is the period the record is meant to be acted on. The two axes are independent: the phenomenon window is fixed by the measurement schedule, while the advisory window is set by the issuing authority and may span several averaging windows. Note: the periods that this specification pairs with phenomenonTimeRelation use the half-open convention [start,end); averagingWindowEnd is therefore excluded from the phenomenon window under that convention.

advisoryId.description: Unique identifier for this advisory record.

monitoringSite.description: Identifier of the air-quality monitoring site at which PM2.5 was measured.

averagingWindowStart.description: Start of the one-hour averaging window over which the mean PM2.5 concentration was computed. Together with averagingWindowEnd, this forms the phenomenon-time period: the window of the world the result is about. This specification pairs phenomenonTimeStart/End with phenomenonTimeRelation using half-open [start,end) periods, so the start instant is included in the window.

averagingWindowEnd.description: End of the one-hour averaging window. Under the half-open [start,end) convention that this specification pairs with phenomenonTimeRelation, this instant is excluded from the phenomenon window.

advisoryEffectiveAt.description: Start of the period during which this advisory is in force. effectiveTimeStart and effectiveTimeEnd form an axis independent of the phenomenon-time axis; the advisory window is set by the issuing authority and may extend well beyond the one-hour averaging window that produced the result.

advisoryExpiresAt.description: End of the period during which this advisory is in force.

meanPm25.description: Arithmetic mean of PM2.5 mass concentration over the one-hour averaging window.

aqiCategory.description: Air Quality Index category assigned to this advisory by the issuing authority.

description.good: Air quality is satisfactory and poses little or no risk.
description.moderate: Air quality is acceptable, but there is a risk for people unusually sensitive to air pollution.
description.unhealthy-sensitive: Members of sensitive groups may experience health effects; the general public is unlikely to be affected.
description.unhealthy: Some members of the general public may experience health effects; sensitive groups may experience more serious ones.
description.very-unhealthy: Health alert: the risk of health effects is increased for everyone.
description.hazardous: Health warning of emergency conditions; everyone is more likely to be affected.
